checkpoint_rule: one shared epoch; per-component validation-only gate; task-normalized gain averaged equally across components and configurations; ties fewer switches then earlier epoch
evaluation_cache: reuse unchanged inherited individual when exact chromosome/scenario key is still valid; new constructed solutions are charged, even if an earlier unrelated individual had the same chromosome
training_balance: each gradient update equally averages 3 components x 9 configurations; same batch-count per minibatch
loss: legal-pair magnitude-weighted softplus ranking; no regression term
scope: shared supervision only; terminal joint PPO follows a separate stage
historical_feedback_role: quick pretraining diagnostic only; full model refits scaling and trains fresh using full-budget data
initialization: preserve Base capacity and greedy seed slots; Directed/K8 only on remaining random slots
cm_collection: one Base trajectory shared by C and M per instance; private audit randomness; rule candidate included
